templates.name: Ashknife Cell at the Contract Market
templates.summary: Assassins collapse a contract-market ward and strike from shuttered stalls.

cues.signal: Every contract bell stops on the same note and awnings drop in sequence.
cues.inference: A coordinated isolation ambush is beginning.

stakes.headline: Survive the cell without letting its paymaster erase the market ledgers.

approaches.label: Break the isolation ward and fight

onSuccess.summary: The cell is defeated and the market ward stabilizes.

onPartial.summary: Damage is committed while a separate cost is paid.

onFailure.summary: The enemy lands a resolved hit and danger rises; the encounter state cannot remain unchanged.

approaches.lockout: Each combat action changes HP, resources, position, or danger before it can be offered again.

approaches.label: Flee through the archive turnstile

onSuccess.summary: The player escapes into the warded archive while the market enters lockdown.

onPartial.summary: Escape succeeds with a visible injury or lost carried item.

onFailure.summary: The current route closes, danger advances, and a different route or tactic is required.

approaches.lockout: Failure locks the current route and modifies the next flee option.

approaches.label: Expose the captured Ashknife seal

onSuccess.summary: The assassins withdraw to protect their paymaster.

onFailure.summary: The offer is rejected and discredited; the same concession cannot be repeated.

approaches.lockout: The leverage is consumed on success or discredited on refusal.

config.fleeRule: opposed success/danger clocks; route locks after failed attempt
config.parleyRule: requires named leverage and threshold; consume or discredit once

forcedTerminal.summary: At the bound, wardens drag the player through the archive gate; escape succeeds with a cut and market lockdown.

resolution.antiRepeatRule: Every action mutates HP, a clock, a resource, position, legality, or terminal state.

example.telegraphProse: The contract bells stop together; silk awnings snap down and a dropped coin rolls uphill toward a broken ward.
example.stakesProse: Fight to secure the ledgers, flee through the warded archive at a stamina cost, or expose a captured Ashknife seal after the leader is wounded.
example.resolutionProse: Each exchange changes HP or the danger clock; a failed escape locks that route, and the sixth turn forces a costly archive extraction.
example.receiptProse: Victory records XP, an assassin-tier drop, and restored market security; flight records lockdown and opens the paymaster investigation.
